data.summary:
Senior Production Support Engineer and .NET Developer with 8 years of experience stabilizing enterprise .NET/C# platforms across Banking, Insurance, Healthcare, and Airlines. Combines hands-on development expertise (C#, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, MS SQL, Kafka, JavaScript) with end-to-end ownership of Sev-1/Sev-2 incident response — from triage and cross-functional coordination through root cause analysis and permanent fixes. Manages the full ITIL Incident, Change, and Problem Management lifecycle in Jira and ServiceNow, consistently sustaining 96% SLA compliance while reducing recurring incidents by 30% through proactive, not reactive, resolution.
Own Sev-1/Sev-2 escalations across 4 employers in regulated, high-availability domains (Banking, Insurance, Healthcare, Airlines)
Coordinate cross-functional response across Engineering, Product, QA, and DevOps, driving RCA-based fixes that cut recurrence by 30%
Run the full ITIL Incident, Change, and Problem Management lifecycle in Jira and ServiceNow, sustaining 96% SLA compliance
Debug end-to-end across the application stack — C#, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, MS SQL, Kafka, JavaScript — not just a single layer
CORE SKILLS & KEYWORDS
Production Support, Application Support, Product Support, L2/L3 Technical Support, Enterprise Software Support, Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), SLA Management, ITIL ServiceNow, Jira, Ticketing Systems, Knowledge Base (KB) Documentation, SOPs C#, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework, VB.Net, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML, CSS MS SQL Server, Database Troubleshooting, Kafka, Application Debugging, Log Analysis Azure, AWS, Azure DevOps, CI/CD, Windows, Linux, Application Monitoring, Performance Tuning Regression Testing, Smoke Testing, Functional Testing, Release Validation, Production Deployment Support

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Production Support Engineer (L2/L3), GTT Data Solutions (formerly Antworks) — Bengaluru, India | Feb 2024 – Present Supporting an AI/OCR-driven Intelligent Document Processing (IDP) platforms used by enterprise clients across Banking, Airlines, Healthcare, and Insurance. Technology Stack: C#, .NET MVC, MS SQL, JavaScript, Linux, Kafka. Ticketing System: Jira.
Own Sev-1/Sev-2 escalations for an AI/OCR document processing platform serving Banking, Airlines, Healthcare, and Insurance clients, sustaining 96% SLA compliance across 40+ tickets/month
Hands-on experience in US Healthcare Payer operations, supporting claims, eligibility, benefits, enrollment, and membership-related processes.
• Coordinate Engineering, Product, QA, and DevOps during critical incidents, cutting average MTTR 25%
Convert root cause analysis (RCA) findings into permanent fixes, cutting recurrence of top issue categories 30% • Manage Incident, Change, and Problem Management end-to-end in Jira, aligned to ITIL practice • Debug application logs, MS SQL queries, and Kafka message flows across 15+ production environments • Monitor application health, servers, and background services, resolving 50+ alerts/month with zero missed Sev-1 SLA breaches
Provided production support for payer/health insurance applications, troubleshooting issues across claims adjudication, provider networks, premiums, and member services.
Validate bug fixes pre-release via regression, smoke, and functional testing across 20+ releases • Automate log-triage and health-check reporting, saving 6 hours/week • Author and maintain 25+ knowledge base articles and SOPs, cutting resolution time for common issues 15%
Senior Software Engineer, Tech Mahindra — Hyderabad, India | Jul 2022 – Nov 2023 Project: Commercial Lines Automation System (CLAS) and Small Business (SMB) — insurance quoting, renewal, and policy endorsement platforms for Selective Insurance. Technology Stack: C#, .NET MVC, VB.Net, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, MS SQL.
Developed and enhanced CLAS/SMB backend features using C#, VB.Net, and SQL Server in an Agile SDLC, supporting 50+ agents
Resolved 30+ production bugs per quarter, improving policy-processing turnaround time 20% • Managed source control and release coordination via TFVC across 10+ sprint releases
Systems Engineer, Tata Consultancy Services — Hyderabad, India | Jul 2017 – Jul 2022 Project: Humana — Corporate Web Systems. Technology Stack: C#, .NET, MS SQL. • Supported US Healthcare payer applications covering claims processing, member eligibility, benefits, enrollment, and
provider-related workflows, providing L2/L3 production support and troubleshooting.
Handled production issues across payer/health-insurance processes including claims adjudication, membership, eligibility, benefits, provider networks, and premium-related workflows, with RCA and permanent resolution.
Supported Humana's corporate web applications, resolving 60+ incidents/month via ServiceNow • Managed incident, change, and problem management in ServiceNow, sustaining 95% SLA compliance • Monitored and troubleshot application performance using Azure DevOps, Univiewer Console, and Dynatrace, reducing downtime 20%
Project: PepsiCo — R&D Web Systems. Technology Stack: C#, ASP.NET MVC, MS SQL.
Owned production alerts as primary contact for infrastructure incidents affecting 5,000+ users, sustaining 99.5% uptime
Delivered web application enhancements using C# and ASP.NET MVC, reducing recurring service requests 25% • Monitored batch jobs and critical servers, catching 10+ issues/month before customer impact
